name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Adds Plex as a federation source, alongside other Jellyfin servers. This plugin now talks to a Plex Media Server's own HTTP API and translates its libraries/items into the same shape as any other federated content, so a friend's Plex catalog flows through the existing sync, cache and stream-relay pipeline unchanged - merging with (and deduplicating against, via IMDb/TMDB/TVDB ids) content from Jellyfin sources in the same local library. Built as a pluggable provider (IExternalCatalogProvider) rather than a Plex-specific path, so supporting another non-Jellyfin product later is a matter of implementing that interface, not touching the sync/stream pipeline again. Verified end-to-end against a real Plex server over Tailscale Funnel: library listing, movie/show/episode metadata (including provider-id extraction for dedup and codec/container details for direct-play checks), and stream resolution all confirmed correct. No UI yet for adding a Plex server - that's next; for now it's configured directly. 256 tests, all green.
